conventional rifles have a fire control group

a magazine in front of that

and a barrel going from the magazine forward

a bullpup moves the fire control group in front of the magazine

this is complicated to design and even harder to do well

but the tradeoff is a much more compact design

a bullpup can have the same barrel length as a conventional design while being 10 inches shorter in overall length

in a world where more and more our infantry are being transported in vehicles both on the ground and in the air this can be a decided advantage

the fire control uses an interesting striker fired design powered by a spring in line with the recoil spring

the weapon uses a short stroke gas system with three gas settings including 1 for normal 2 for dirty and 0 for rifle grenade

the weapon uses 30 rd magazines that rock in like an ak

a rail system is added on the top carry handle for optics

and the barrel was modified to work with the newer versions of their 5.8 round

variants were also made including a carbine a squad automatic a sniper variant and recalibered models

overall the qbz95 is not spectacular but it can be called a success
